name: Hi no Hikari no Shita de 3 Yuua no Baai
original_name: 日の光の下で3 祐亜の場合
source:
Yua Ishida was an ordinary girl until she becomes allergic to fabrics. She can no longer wear clothing; she needs to spend naked all day long while she continues to go to school.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE143784.html]DLsite English[/url]]
